scope: Completed runtime-linked cinematic MP4s only; no game, server, browser, held team candidate, source modification or publication.

world.runtimeVttParity: EN and KO external VTT each match actual v13 JS data: 32 cues; no text/timing mismatches to 0.00051s tolerance.
world.audioDescription: Embedded English VO decodes correctly. Game cinematic music is a separate _cinBgm Audio object (index.html:2416), not established as embedded in this MP4. Source-only upload does not reproduce the runtime music mix.

visualQa.motionSamples: Each of 12 sample locations inspected at t, t+0.1, t+0.2s (nearest source frames): 36 frames per movie, in two contact sheets.
visualQa.boundaryQa: Additional 16 warrior and 12 world frames inspected.
visualQa.finding: No exposed browser/game/debug UI, missing scene subjects, unexpected black interval, full-frame flash, or visible render corruption in reviewed samples. Cinematic characters and environments remain consistently framed.
visualQa.limits: Not continuous human playback of every frame. Full decode and frame-level dimensions/PTS/luma checks cover complete timeline; visual assessment uses explicit samples.

objectiveFrameChecks.flashLimit: These thresholds use full-frame average luma and do not certify absence of small/local visual flashes.

audioQa.limitation: No claim of full English speech intelligibility, accent, musical balance or native-language acceptance from waveform/statistics alone.

subtitles.type: Sidecar subtitles; no hardcoded captions or embedded text-track stream in source MP4s.
